body:
Wider native speculation can lose the original scalar reference even when its matched target control passes. This additive study completes the remaining RTX task, length/width and persistent-request gates from #60, then tests a bounded fixed-microbatch amendment derived from the state diagnosis. It retains the original negative boundaries and separates output qualification from practical extra speed.

**Results:** B qualifies all 24 pre-output exposure-audited MBPP tasks under four conditions and four balanced repeats. Original C qualifies k1/UB2 and k3/UB4 at caps128/256/512; MBPP/229 fails k5/UB6 and k7/UB8 at every cap/repeat. The topology probe HumanEval/18 also fails its original reference under UB6/8 in target-alone and speculative modes. D qualifies the original k3/UB4 profile in two resident cycles with separate reset capture and timing.

**Local state evidence:** naturally aligned MBPP/229 donor states at 47 committed tokens are crossed with two current UB6 layouts. All four same-path shams and source-unchanged checks pass. State swapping changes the local EOS decision; current-layout swapping changes scores without changing that decision. The two caps expose the same task/boundary, not independent cases. This is not a unique operator or full-continuation proof.

**Final fixed-UB amendment:** declared before C4 outputs and explicitly after primary B/C/D. Fixing UB4 qualifies k3/5/7 on all28 pilot tasks; actual k7 callers reach8 while occupied microqueries remain<=4. Highest qualified k7 is selected by outputs only, then checked in independent balanced sessions. The same tasks are reused, without a held-out-task claim.

| Complete-reference comparison | Generation | Whole request |
|---|---:|---:|
| wider_speculation / anchor_speculation | 0.829442x | 0.889868x |
| wider_speculation / matched_target | 0.997404x | 0.950353x |
| anchor_speculation / matched_target | 1.202501x | 1.067970x |

k7's practical extra-speed gate versus original k3 is **FAIL**. All three constrained/target modes match full references; ordinary k7/UB4 fails MBPP/229, MBPP/274, HumanEval/25 and HumanEval/18, so its costs stay diagnostic. The independent cap256/512 scalar/target/selected confirmation is reported in the long results. No further RTX retuning follows.

**Validation and scope:** 2318 complete generations (2212 nonwarm, 106 warmups) plus 8 paid auxiliary target decodes. Post-audit PASS verifies both model identities, 33 released DLLs, prior source/binary assets, frozen runners, full counts and output endpoints. All failures, the offline zero-model summary correction, exact private source and raw records are retained in a separate content-addressed local archive. Original C2/C3 confirmation gates are skipped. No new reliable acceleration from relaxing draft scopes or increasing lookahead is claimed.

Read `benchmarks/rtx_closeout_bcd/README.md`, `REPORT.md`, `results/CLOSEOUT_SUMMARY.json`, and the tables/figures. Only this additive directory is changed; the manuscript and earlier PRs remain in the user integration workflow. Weights, runtime binaries, raw telemetry and native output/float arrays are excluded from GitHub.

RTX closeout means the frozen questions have finite answers, including failures. It does not mean universal losslessness, functional code correctness, production throughput, globally optimal widths/scopes, journal acceptance or cross-platform validity. B570 is not run in this tranche and needs its own paid native reference and platform-specific qualification.

Final delivery: the immutable local CAS ZIP is 122,395,102 bytes, SHA256 `88ff7d52da4815dee11d7232e36b292fd77fe18a414e01aca41e860cdd4cade5`, with CRC and all object hashes verified. All10,151 files were successfully restored with the Windows extended destination prefix; exact runtime restore and four no-model version smoke checks pass. Windows notes were added after packaging without rewriting the frozen source-history archive (local head250058d).

Public validation: all80 final files were read back and verified against intended Git blobs (four unchanged preregistration files additionally compared to their frozen ancestor). The eight-commit comparison to main e87291d contains only additions under benchmarks/rtx_closeout_bcd/. The PR remains draft; no manuscript or prior PR is merged by this study.
